after-the-hand-in-the-sand.player: They arrested Sandy for the murder of a wizard and the sand pit now refills itself!

after-the-hand-in-the-sand.npc: ME JOB! I'VE LOSTED ME JOB! 'ow c'n yer say tha' be good news?? Me wife'll tear me limb fr'm limb!

after-the-hand-in-the-sand.player: Don't worry, the Wizards are going to pay you a large pension so that you can retire...

after-the-hand-in-the-sand.npc: Bu' wha'll I be doin' wit' me day now! I be lovin' tha sand.

after-the-hand-in-the-sand.player: What will you do with your day? Well....You could build sand castles with your own two hands!

after-the-hand-in-the-sand.npc: I din't think so... bu' iffen yer ever need someone ta haul buckets o'sand 'round, ye be lettin' me know [player name], I's can help yer!

after-the-hand-in-the-sand.player: Wow! That would be great, buckets of sand direct to bank everday you say? That's great!

after-the-hand-in-the-sand.text: Once per day you may ask Bert to help you by carrying 84 buckets of sand to your bank. Just talk to him!

options.text: Can you deliver my sand to my bank, please?

steps.player: Can you deliver my sand to my bank, please?

steps.text: If the player has space for the sand in their bank:

steps.npc: Aye, give me a minute cause I be rushed off me feet!

steps.text: Bert delivers the sand to your bank.

steps.player: Hello Bert, could I have my sand today please?

steps.npc: Aye, give me a minute cause I be rushed off me feet!

steps.player: Hope you're having a good day!

steps.npc: Oh arr, no' too bad, though sometoimes, I could do wi' a second pair o' hands! I'll be gettin' on movin' them there buckets o' sand to yer bank!

steps.text: Bert delivers the sand to your bank.

steps.npc: I'll ge' on wi' movin' it. Thankee fer makin' sure Sandy go' it in t'neck fer 'is double dealin's!

steps.text: Bert delivers the sand to your bank.
If the player has no space for the sand in their bank, or is an Ultimate Ironman:

steps.npc: Eeee, ye've go' no free space in yon bank [player name]. Make some room 'tween the fishes 'n boots fore ye come back ta me.

steps.player: Ok, I'll make some more space in my bank and come back!

options.text: Did you already give me some sand today?
options.condition: If the player has already claimed their sand for the day:

steps.player: Did you already give me some sand today?

steps.npc: Yep, I dropped it off a while ago. Mebbe come back tomorrow fer some more.

options.text: Please don't notify me when you deliver sand
options.condition: If the player has completed the Elite Ardougne Diary:

steps.player: Please don't notify me when you deliver sand.

steps.npc: Aye, when I take yer bucket o' sand to yer bank each day, I'll not bother ye wi' any messages 'bout it. Ye'll just find yer sand in there.

options.text: Can you notify me when you deliver sand?
options.condition: If the player has completed the Elite Ardougne Diary:

steps.player: Can you notify me when you deliver sand?

steps.npc: Aye, when I takes yer bucket o' sand to yer bank each day, I'll drop ye a message ter tell yer 'bout it, so ye knows I been workin'!

options.text: I no longer want daily sand deliveries.

steps.player: I no longer want sand deliveries.

steps.npc: Suits me, [player name]! I be a wee bi' busy, an' I'll happily stop takin' sand to  yer bank for ye. Come an' see me if ye changes yer mind.

options.text: Did you already give me some sand today?
I'd like daily sand deliveries again

steps.player: I'd like daily sand deliveries again.

steps.npc: Aye, ye bin a big help to me, an I'll be 'appy to take yer sand to yer bank.
